run_text: Semantic audit of the git-delta-v1 working-tree delta against source_head 82178cd (97 files, +10410/-1241). Full tests/Run-Tests.ps1 was executed first as baseline: exit 0, ALL TESTS PASSED. Every finding below is therefore a gap the suite does not cover, not a regression the suite caught. Severity P1 = user-visible wrong install or unrecoverable loss of the only recovery authority; P2 = wrong behaviour on a real path; P3 = latent or doc/behaviour mismatch. IMP-001 [P1] [LOGIC_ERROR] [proven] [ticket] expected: Select-TfPreferenceRow resolves the Fonts-tab selection by stable fontSlug against the rows the ListBox actually shows. actual: desktop/WintageInstaller.ps1:1565 iterates i over $lstTfFonts.Items.Count (the FILTERED list) but reads $script:TfRows[$i], the UNFILTERED catalog; the sibling accessor Get-TfSelectedRow at :1458 correctly uses $script:TfVisibleRows. evidence: sed -n '1555,1575p' shows `$row = $script:TfRows[$i]`; grep shows TfVisibleRows assigned at :1438-1449 and consumed at :1457-1458 but never at :1565. With catalog [A,B] filtered to [B] and prevSlug A, i=0 matches TfRows[0]=A, the function returns true and sets SelectedIndex=0, which selects visible row B; the metrics label, preview and enabled Apply button then describe B while the manifest/registry write records B as a re-apply of A. Callers: :1583, :1607 (every search keystroke), :1653, :1791. IMP-002 [P1] [LOGIC_ERROR] [proven] [ticket] expected: a pre-Wintage DWM AccentColorInactive backup is preserved so that -Target windows -Revert can restore the user's real accent. actual: desktop/modules/common.ps1:1085 treats a missing .provenance.json sidecar as proof of truncation and unconditionally Remove-Item's the backup, then re-captures the CURRENT registry value as the pristine one. evidence: sed -n '1074,1090p' shows the adoption branch above and the bare `Remove-Item $WINDOWS_DWM_BACKUP -Force` at :1085, reached whenever no sidecar exists. $WINDOWS_DWM_BACKUP is \recovery\windows-dwm-settings.json, a stable cross-version path not swept by Prune-Backups, so 'no sidecar' is exactly the state of every backup written by a build predating Write-RecoveryProvenance, while Assert-RecoveryProvenance at :667 deliberately treats a missing stamp as adoptable everywhere else. Backup-WindowsInactiveAccent is called from targets.ps1:1849 BEFORE this run's accent write, so the value captured is the previous Wintage run's themed accent. A later -Revert writes that themed value back as the original and the user's genuine desktop accent is gone, with no error and no surviving evidence. IMP-003 [P2] [LOGIC_ERROR] [reproduced] [ticket] expected: the GoodEmoji plugin only converts real emoji characters in message text, as it did before this delta. actual: desktop/targets/betterdiscord/plugins/GoodEmoji.plugin.js:433 (and :442, :447) registers ~3100 shortcode strings such as ':rat:', ':x:', ':punch:', ':hole:' into this.textMap, which is consumed by processTextNode and processReaction across every text node in document.body. evidence: `git show HEAD:...GoodEmoji.plugin.js | grep 'textMap\['` returns exactly one writer, `this.textMap[item.from] = item.to;` at HEAD:245; the delta replaces that shape with the shortcode writers at :433-447. Executed by the audit seat: 'lol :x: is my vote' -> 'lol :white_circle: is my vote', 'I saw a :rat: in the lab' -> 'I saw a :hamster: in the lab'. Discord does not parse these, so the user sees their own authored text silently mutated into different literal text. IMP-004 [P2] [LOGIC_ERROR] [proven] [ticket] expected: the JS half of the theme (surface remapping, floating-panel solidification, hover-rule surgery) runs on ordinary hosts and is disabled only on the named high-churn chat SPAs. actual: vintage.user.js:215 adds IS_LOCAL to HIGH_CHURN_HOST, and CSS_ONLY_MODE = HIGH_CHURN_HOST at :216, so every localhost, 127.0.0.1, 0.0.0.0 and *.local host now runs CSS-only. evidence: sed -n '209,216p' shows `const HIGH_CHURN_HOST = IS_X || IS_CHATGPT || IS_LOCAL || /.../;` followed by `const CSS_ONLY_MODE = HIGH_CHURN_HOST;`. With @match *://*/* this covers http://localhost:* and every mDNS dev host. The file's own doc at :205-208 states CSS_ONLY_MODE means no document-wide MutationObserver, no full-DOM sweeps, no CSSOM hover surgery, which disables startObservers (:3246), the CSSStyleSheet instrumentation (:2108) and HOVER_PAINT (:2098), contradicting the @description's own claims. The change carries no justifying comment while every other narrowing in this delta does. IMP-005 [P2] [LOGIC_ERROR] [proven] [ticket] expected: an element overlapping artwork is left unpainted so the image is not covered. actual: vintage.user.js:2741 narrows the floating-surface media hit test from 'video, audio, canvas, img, picture, svg' to 'video, audio, canvas', so anything stacked over an img, picture or inline svg is now repainted as an opaque T.surfaceRaised rectangle with a bevel. evidence: `git diff -U1 HEAD -- wintage.user.js` shows the old `(u.closest && u.closest('video, audio, canvas, img, picture, svg'))` and the matching `u.querySelector(...)` lines deleted; sed -n '2738,2743p' confirms the narrowed test in the current file. Video/canvas still match, so YouTube overlays are unaffected and the regression is easy to miss; hero badges, carousel captions and avatar overlays are not. IMP-006 [P2] [LOGIC_ERROR] [proven] [ticket] expected: the main Apply and Revert status line names only the targets that actually failed. actual: desktop/WintageInstaller.ps1:3254 and :3309 read $child.Output and pass $child to Get-BatchFailures, but the streaming completion path hands OnDone the batch STATE object (:3070-3073, `& $completionHandler $st`), whose keys are OnDone/ExitCode/Process/Result/BatchResults (:2724-2735) and which has no Output property at all. evidence: sed -n '3068,3074p' shows the normalization branch passing $st; sed -n '2724-2735p' shows the state hashtable keys; Get-BatchFailures at :3141 begins `if (-not $result -or -not $result.Output) { return $failed }` so it always returns @(). Therefore at :3259 `$failed = @($keys)` fires whenever ExitCode -ne 0, and the status line reports ALL keys as failures. Install 12 targets with one failure and the user is told nothing was installed for any of them; the per-target Classify-BatchResult/$script:BatchResults model is never consulted on this path. Only the Tf handler at :1695 was updated to the new shape. IMP-007 [P2] [LOGIC_ERROR] [observed] [ticket] expected: Backup-WindowsInactiveAccent adopts a legacy backup only when it parses, as its own comment and doc state. actual: desktop/modules/common.ps1:1081 discards the ConvertFrom-Json result inside a try with an empty catch and then falls through to an unconditional return, so the function adopts the backup whether or not it is valid JSON. evidence: sed -n '1079,1084p' shows `try { Read-Utf8 $WINDOWS_DWM_BACKUP | ConvertFrom-Json | Out-Null } catch { }` immediately followed by `return`. The preceding comment at :1075-1078 states 'Only accept a parse-valid, provenance-valid/adoptable legacy backup' and the check does not exist. tools/test-dwm-recovery.ps1:68 only regex-matches the words NOT validity / parse-valid / ConvertFrom-Json, so the suite passes. A truncated backup is then accepted as authoritative and the throw surfaces much later, inside Restore-WindowsInactiveAccent at :1115, after Invoke-WindowsTheme has already dispatched the theme activation (targets.ps1:1858) and the Remove-ManifestEntry transaction has begun. IMP-008 [P2] [LOGIC_ERROR] [observed] [ticket] expected: a Fonts-tab Apply writes the effective palette, including a custom one the user has edited. actual: desktop/WintageInstaller.ps1:1682 forwards $script:current to install.ps1 -Palette verbatim; the GUI-internal sentinel '' is normalized only on the main Apply path (:3245) and not here. evidence: sed -n '1678,1686p' passes `-Palette $script:current`; install.ps1 then joins themes\$PaletteSlug.json (targets.ps1:1235 and the conhost twin) into themes\.json, which does not exist. $script:current becomes '' either via :3337 or via a snapshot preset at :3538, so any user with an edited Custom palette fails every Fonts-tab Apply: install-terminal.js exits non-zero, the target rolls back, and the log reports apply FAILED. IMP-009 [P2] [LOGIC_ERROR] [reproduced] [ticket] expected: stop() fully undoes start(), and start() is safe to call twice. actual: desktop/targets/betterdiscord/plugins/GoodEmoji.plugin.js:286 pushes [name, orig] onto this.__historyRestore without resetting it, and :340 replays that stack in INSERTION order instead of unwinding it, so the most recent wrapper wins over the native it is supposed to restore. evidence: sed -n '279,290p' shows `this.__historyRestore = this.__historyRestore || []; this.__historyRestore.push([name, orig]);`; sed -n '338,343p' shows `for (const [name, orig] of this.__historyRestore) { try { history[name] = orig; } catch (e) { } }`. Executed by the audit seat: start(); start(); stop() leaves pushState bound to the plugin wrapper, __historyRestore length 4, and 'route change after stop() still calls the plugin: true'. The wrapper closes over the plugin instance, so the instance is never collected and a DISABLED plugin keeps mutating the DOM. Trigger: double-toggle of the BetterDiscord enable switch, or BD's own re-init on plugin update. IMP-010 [P3] [LOGIC_ERROR] [observed] [ticket] expected: the Fonts-tab Refresh button and the rendering-mode combo box are separately clickable. actual: desktop/WintageInstaller.ps1:1238 places $cmbTfRendering at '660,154' size '140,20' and :1272 places $btnTfRefresh at '660,158' size '96,24'; the overlap rect is [660,158]-[756,174] and the button is later in $pnlFonts.Controls.AddRange (:1985), so it is on top in z-order. evidence: the two Location/Size literals overlap as computed above. Clicking anywhere in the left 96 px of the combobox re-probes fonts and logs 'font state re-probed' while the combobox never opens; only the dropdown arrow (x approximately 782-800) is reachable. IMP-011 [P3] [LOGIC_ERROR] [observed] [ticket] expected: a themed button cannot contain a site-styled nested surface. actual: vintage.user.js:1072 narrows the button-label wipe from all descendants to direct children ('button:not(.ytp-button) > *:not(i):...'), so markup two levels deep keeps the site's own background, border and box-shadow inside the Win95 bevel. evidence: the current selector at :1072 uses the child combinator '>' where the pre-delta rule matched any descendant. For '' the no longer matches and renders as a mismatched patch inside the button. Every other selector narrowing in this delta carries a rationale comment; this one carries none. IMP-012 [P3] [LOGIC_ERROR] [observed] [ticket] expected: an invalid terminal-font.json fails the terminal target, not the whole unattended reapply. actual: desktop/modules/targets.ps1:654 calls Get-ConhostOwnedFont unwrapped inside Test-TargetNeedsReapply, and that helper throws by design when terminal-font.json fails schema validation (json-doc.ps1:120). The same unguarded shape exists for Process Explorer at :683. evidence: install.ps1:359 invokes Test-TargetNeedsReapply unwrapped from the foreach planning loop of the -Reapply branch. A hand-edited or truncated terminal-font.json (for example "size": 30 against the documented 7..24 range) aborts install.ps1 -Reapply -Quiet during PLANNING, before any target is touched, so the logon task (common.ps1:714) dies with a red stack trace and no target is repaired. The terminal-side call at :527 is wrapped but reports a misleading reason. IMP-013 [P3] [LOGIC_ERROR] [reproduced] [ticket] expected: stop() cancels every timer the plugin armed. actual: desktop/targets/betterdiscord/plugins/GoodEmoji.plugin.js:268 re-nulls this.sweepTimer in start() instead of clearing any timer still armed in it, so an id armed by a previous start() becomes unreachable from stop() at :330. evidence: sed -n '264,270p' shows `this.sweepTimer = null;` with no preceding clearTimeout. Executed by the audit seat: start(); requestReconcile(2000); start(); stop() leaves 1 uncancellable pending timer that still fires reconcile() against a stopped plugin. Same trigger class as IMP-009. IMP-014 [P3] [LOGIC_ERROR] [proven] [ticket] expected: the machine-readable wintage-result record is sanitised before it enters the line-oriented stream. actual: desktop/install.ps1:866 applies `-replace '"', '"'`, which replaces a double quote with a double quote: " is not a regex metacharacter and is not a $ group reference, so the line is a no-op that reads as a sanitiser and provides none. evidence: sed -n '864,867p' shows the exact expression. Not currently harmful because target names are constrained to the ValidateSet, but it is the only defence the record has and it is dead code introduced by this delta. IMP-015 [P3] [LOGIC_ERROR] [observed] [note] expected: $script:fbPreviewPending gates persistence of a freebuff preview pick, as its comment at :687-688 claims. actual: desktop/WintageInstaller.ps1:945 assigns it and :728 clears it, but nothing ever reads it; persistence is driven entirely by the $onVerified callback at :1027-1031. evidence: grep for fbPreviewPending returns only the write at :945 and the clear at :728. Harmless but it contradicts its own documentation and will mislead the next reader. IMP-016 [P3] [LOGIC_ERROR] [observed] [ticket] expected: the Process Explorer recovery reader validates the shape of the ledger it is about to trust, as its sibling readers do. actual: desktop/modules/targets.ps1:3673 only rejects a MISSING values property; if values parses as an array, a number or a string, $meta.values.PSObject.Properties[$n] returns $null for every name at :3678, so every entry becomes $null and Restore-ProcessExplorerState at :3585-3591 takes the delete branch for all 24 owned colours. The marker is lost the same way when absent. evidence: compare Read-NppRecoveryLedger at :2998-3013 and Read-C4dRecovery at :3223-3230, both of which reject non-object roots and per-entry field types. The $pristine.Existed value computed at :3682 and written faithfully at :3729 is also never read by Restore-ProcessExplorerState, so a first-touch Revert strands the registry key it created. IMP-017 [P3] [LOGIC_ERROR] [observed] [ticket] expected: the plugin matches the skin-tone shortcode syntax Discord actually emits. actual: desktop/targets/betterdiscord/plugins/GoodEmoji.plugin.js:445 builds ':' + n + '::skin-tone-' + (i+1) + ':' (double colon) and registers it in nameToItem and textMap, while the real syntax is ':name:skin-tone-N:' with a single separator; the strip regex at :477 encodes the same wrong format. evidence: executed by the audit seat: the real-syntax attribute ':cry:skin-tone-3:' matches nothing, the invented ':cry::skin-tone-3:' matches, and 2025 of the 6144 alternatives in the 101 KB compiled pattern exist only to match a string no Discord surface produces. One third of the pattern is dead weight and the real case is unhandled. IMP-018 [P3] [LOGIC_ERROR] [observed] [ticket] expected: a page that relies on a transparent body over a fixed or gradient backdrop keeps that backdrop. actual: vintage.user.js:957 drops 'body' from the transparent-surface rule, while body is set to T.backgroundSoft !important at :862 and the root is painted T.background at :533; the later transparent rule no longer resets it. evidence: the current selector list at :957 begins 'main, section, article, aside, footer' with no body term. Any site with a full-bleed hero, fixed or animated page background now gets a flat T.backgroundSoft band painted over it. Global, unscoped, and carrying no comment unlike the ChatGPT composer fix two hunks below. IMP-019 [P3] [LOGIC_ERROR] [observed] [ticket] expected: every Save-DirPreState snapshot is either restored or completed, never stranded. actual: desktop/install.ps1:1239 takes $preDest = Save-DirPreState $dest before the branch, and the else arm at :1321 (nothing to revert) neither restores nor completes it before the continue at :1326. evidence: sed -n '1318,1327p' shows the restored arm calling Complete-DirPreState $preDest and the else arm calling neither. Reachable when ~/.vscode/extensions/wintage-themes exists but recovery/vscode/recovery.json is absent and Test-LegacyWintageExtension is false; a full recursive copy of the extension tree is left in TEMP on every such run. The same completion call was added at the four sibling sites in this delta, so this is the one path that was missed. IMP-020 [P3] [LOGIC_ERROR] [observed] [note] expected: the header comment's 'adaptive backoff' on the reconcile window is implemented, as :16-19 and :305-308 describe. actual: desktop/targets/betterdiscord/plugins/GoodEmoji.plugin.js:308 multiplies this.reconcileDelay into a new value, but both callers pass literals (:272 requestReconcile(0), :275 requestReconcile(RECONCILE_MIN_MS)), so the accumulator is never read and GoodEmoji.RECONCILE_MAX_MS is used nowhere else. evidence: the two call sites are the only requestReconcile callers and neither passes this.reconcileDelay. The window is permanently pinned at 250 ms. Coalescing still works via the clearTimeout re-arm at :299, so this is a documentation/behaviour mismatch rather than a stall.
